title: Oz by The Sea
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “Oz by The Sea”, a luxury 8-bed, 7.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 29 guests, this home offers a Private Pool & Spa, Game Room, Elevator & Golf Cart. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights: - Gulf Views - Private Resort-Style Pool and Spa (Pool can be heated for an additional $50 per day between Oct 1 - May 1) - Putting Green - Elevator - 6 Seater Golf Cart Included - 6 Adult Bicycles Included - New Construction - Short Walk to the Beach -Game Room This newly built residence combines modern sophistication with coastal charm, offering an elevated experience for guests seeking both relaxation and style along the shores of Inlet Beach. Expansive rooftop gulf views set the backdrop for this property and its views and enjoyment. At the heart of the home, the private resort-style pool and spa invite both tranquil mornings and lively evening gatherings, with the option to heat the pool (during specific times) for year-round enjoyment. Inside, an elevator provides effortless access to every level, while a spacious game room creates opportunities for leisure and entertainment. A six-seater golf cart and six adult bicycles are included, making it simple to explore nearby communities. Just a short stroll brings you to the sugar-white sands and turquoise waters of the Gulf, while celebrated dining, boutique shopping, and attractions are only minutes away. Whether savoring a sunset from the balcony, sharing a chef-prepared meal, or gathering with loved ones poolside, this home offers the perfect blend of comfort, elegance, and convenience. More than a vacation retreat, it is a sanctuary where memories are made and the beauty of 30A is experienced at its finest. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 29) FIRST FLOOR: • King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only SECOND FLOOR: • Master King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower/Tub separate • Two Full over Full Bunkroom w/ Shared Bathroom • King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only • Jr Master King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only THIRD FLOOR: • Two Full over Full Bunkroom • King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only • King Bedroom + Twin w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only
